notes.title: Announcement: Blazing Ace RoadMap 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43869261/70b6f0b602794e59e907df605af6d7b9e0eeeccd.png[/img]

[h2][b]📣📣Announcement from Kalon Team!! 📣📣[/b][/h2]

 It has been more than 2 months since we have launched Blazing Ace demo on Steam and we appreciate your warm welcoming. Thank you for the interests in our visual novel.

 Right now, we have no plans to update the demo as smaller builds as we are mainly developing the full game of Blazing Ace. We plan to release the game as a full game in one go.

 To make it transparent, we want to make sure that everyone acknowledges our timeline for the game development as follow:

[b] ⭐️Q3 2023[/b]
[i]- Developments will be mainly on resources and assets of Blazing Ace, including but not limited to:[/i]
o Story development
o Character design
o Background design

[b] ⭐️Q4 2023[/b]
- We will focus on:
o Game system optimization
o Finalizing CGs, sprites, and other in-game images
o Music and SFX designs
o Porting Blazing Ace into Android (as a demo)

[b] ⭐️Q1 2024[/b]
- Full game release.

 It might be unfortunate that we will not be able to release the game into smaller, gradual updates due to the very nature of the story in Blazing Ace. Please hang tight and wait for us to wrap up the project.

 Anyhow, we are always available if you have any questions and we will keep you all posted periodically. Also, we will let out some character details (plus new characters) in the near future!

Again, thank you for all of your support!!


 —-Kalon Team—-
